svg.title: Where the St Lawrence Lowlands region reaches
svg.desc: The St Lawrence plain from Québec City upriver past Trois-Rivières, Montréal and Ottawa to Kingston, the Eastern Townships behind it, and the Champlain valley south to Burlington and Plattsburgh. Boundary data: CEC, North American Environmental Atlas — Ecological Regions, Level III (2021), CC BY 4.0 © Commission for Environmental Cooperation.
